name: 1Zpresso ZP6
details: Hand grinder for filter coffee. External dial read in numbers (“points”): 10 clicks per number, 9 numbers per rotation; 4.5 = #4 and 5 clicks.

grindRanges.scale: dial numbers from zero (burrs closed); 4.5 = #4 and 5 clicks

notes.turkish: The ZP6 Special is a filter grinder; 1Zpresso lists no Turkish or espresso range.
notes.espresso: 1Zpresso's ZP6 Special chart lists no espresso range.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “ZP6 Special Grind Setting Reference” chart (ZP6-special-Grind-Setting-Reference-20221031.jpg on that page): siphon/pour over 4–5, French press 5–6 (points).
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: from the top of the espresso range to halfway to the top of the AeroPress range (or one AeroPress span finer when there's no espresso range); AeroPress: between the espresso and pour-over ranges (or one pour-over span finer when there's no espresso range); drip coffee maker: the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
